## What's new

### Password managers in the suggestion strip
Bitwarden, Google Password Manager and other autofill services now show their sign-in suggestions right in the strip above the keys, the way you'd expect from a modern keyboard. Tap one to fill the field. The chips follow the keyboard's light or dark theme, size themselves to fit, and scroll smoothly with clean edges when there are more than fit.

To use it, pick your password manager under **Settings → Passwords & accounts → Autofill service**, and turn on inline (keyboard) suggestions in the password manager's own settings if it has that option. Needs Android 11 or newer.

### The enter key does what the field asks
Search boxes get a search key, chat apps a send key, forms a next or done key, and the key performs that action. Searching in the Play Store and similar apps works again instead of adding a new line.

### Smarter suggestions and fixes
- Spelling and grammar fixes from your phone's spell checker show up in the strip: tap into an underlined word and pick the fix.
- Better typo correction for common spelling mix-ups and missing or extra vowels.
- An undo pill after an autocorrect, to put back what you typed.
- Tapping into a word offers fixes for that word instead of completions.
- Long suggestions stay readable: they squeeze slightly to fit, and a long top suggestion gets the whole strip instead of being cut short.
- Words you learned most recently are offered first.

### Typing feel
- Keys are a little taller, meeting Android's 48dp touch-target guideline, so they're easier to hit.
- Long-press duration is adjustable under **Typing**.
- Holding backspace stops deleting as soon as your finger slides off the key.
- Landscape uses the split layout with a wide space bar by default.
- More room under the bottom row on phones whose navigation bar overlapped it.

### Fixes
- The per cent key on the second symbols page types `%`, not the look-alike care-of sign `℅`.
